scene_type: 2D (top-down / overhead view of a dinner table; mild perspective, see camera)
time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t*fps)
units: pixels (full-resolution 2560x1440 image coordinates, x right, y down) and seconds

camera.content_shift_vs_frame0: image content moves steadily UP by ~43.5 px and right by ~1-4 px over the clip (~ -0.95 px/frame in y); rotation ~-0.2 deg, scale change <0.3 %
camera.per_frame_file: scene/camera_motion.csv (similarity transform frame_i -> frame_0, ORB+RANSAC); scene/camera_shift.csv (raw phase correlation of 4 static patches)
camera.background_compensated_coords: tomato_bowl.csv columns cx_bgcomp_f0, cy_bgcomp_f0 = bowl centre mapped into frame-0 background coordinates
camera.perspective: near-overhead view tilted so that the image bottom is nearer the camera: identical dinner plates measure ~224-238 px across near the top of the table (y~330-550) and ~249-256 px near the bottom (y~940-1235)

tomato_bowl.description: dark grey round bowl full of red cherry tomatoes; the only object that travels substantially. Passed by the curly-haired man (bottom right) up-and-right toward the bald man (right) / pink-blazer diner (top right)
tomato_bowl.reference_point: centre of the fitted outer-rim circle (visible centre)
tomato_bowl.occlusion: always partially covered at the bottom rim by the passer's fingers; from ~frame 28 also the bald man's hand at the right, from ~frame 37 the pink-blazer diner's fingers at the top-left rim

size_px.rim_diameter_frames_32_46: ~159-173 (mean ~167; less reliable, left rim dark against shadow/flowers, +-8 px)
size_px.note: round bowl seen from above: length = width = rim diameter; height not observable

moving_objects.people_and_hands: 8 seated diners move arms/hands (eating, passing); they stay seated, no tracks except notes below

events.event: bowl already in motion at frame 0 (lifted, held by curly-haired man's left hand)
bowl moves almost purely to the right (+x), step speeding up from ~15 to ~24-25 px/frame
direction change: path curves from rightward to upward
bowl moves almost straight up (-y), step ~20 px/frame decreasing
bald man's left hand arrives under/at right side of bowl (contact/hand-over begins)
pink-blazer diner's fingers reach the bowl's top-left rim / tomatoes
bowl essentially stops (steps < ~4 px/frame, jitter level)
end of clip, bowl held stationary above bald man's tagliatelle plate area

static_objects_frame0.plates: scene/plates_f0.json (centre, circle diameter, ellipse axes; ray+RANSAC rim fit)

dining_table (wooden planks, rotated ~-1.note: +-20 px; bottom/left edges hidden by diners

static_objects_frame0.accuracy: plates +-3 px; other items +-10 px (by eye on gridded frame)
